# Test fixtures

- `parses_en.json`, `parses_it.json`: Stanza analyses (aligned to Lapsus tokens) of short
  sentences written by the Lapsus authors for testing. They let the tests run without
  Stanza models.
- `morphit_subset.txt`: entries of the Morph-it! lexicon (Baroni and Zanchetta,
  CC BY-SA 2.0 / LGPL) for the lemmas used in the Italian fixtures. It keeps the
  Morph-it! licence and is used only by the tests.
